[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 62[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2745296]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6330078][color=#ffffff]CTF Challenge $1000+ Prize Pool [CanYouHack.Me and Virtualine.net][/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

With just over 2 weeks remaining on this challenge its great to see all the members getting involved. The 3rd challenge has now been unlocked "Booter" with [mention=1189774] dropping a hint for machine 2 "BlackSunglasses" as It proved more difficult than first thought. Featuring over $1,000 in cash and prizes members can compete by completing cybersecurity challenges to earn crypto, permanent L33t or Ub3r upgrades, and an exclusive CYHM award. Every completed challenge moves you closer to qualifying for the larger prize drawings. Be sure to keep an eye on the original thread for updates and other members progress, best of luck to all members taking part.

[u][b][size=large]God of War[/size][/b][/u]

Updates confirmed that Dave Bautista will step into the role of Kratos for the Prime Video series.

[u][b][size=large]GTA 6 Extortion Stalls[/size][/b][/u]

Cyberleek hackers attempted to blackmail Take-Two Interactive by leaking footage and demanding a public apology alongside an enforceable physical release guarantee. Take-Two has completely ignored the 24-hour ultimatum window.

[u][b][size=large]007 First Light[/size][/b][/u]

IO Interactive marked a commercial milestone, pulling in 4 million sales in its first three months.
